title: af/implement-input@1 Worker input
description: The exact, role-scoped input the implementer receives for one implement Task (ADR-0028, ADR-0046). Worker Input, not a log record: no Task event references it, but it is durable in the CAS and named by `af/worker-evidence@1`'s context manifest.

source_snapshot_id.description: The Snapshot materialized as the implementer's writable sandbox.
